name: Dermatology
tag: Collections, cosmetics, Mohs/pathology, APP leverage, clinic support, partnership, ancillary revenue.
questions: Is compensation base, collections %, or hybrid?
Do cosmetics and pathology revenue count?
Is APP supervision required and paid?

samples.name: Dermatology Private Group
samples.cons: Noncompete, overhead allocation, and ancillary ownership need scrutiny.

samples.name: Hospital Dermatology Clinic
samples.cons: Less cosmetics/ancillary upside; productivity template must be understood.

samples.name: Cosmetic-Heavy Derm Practice
samples.cons: Need clarity on device ownership, collections split, marketing expectations.

Compensation: Is pay base, collections percentage, RVU, net collections, or hybrid?
What percentage of collections is paid and what is excluded?
Do cosmetics, lasers, pathology, retail products, and APP-supervised revenue count toward compensation?
What is the historical collections range for physicians with similar schedules?
Clinical model: How many patients/day and procedures/day are expected?
How many rooms, MAs, scribes, and procedure assistants per dermatologist?
What is the mix of medical derm, cosmetics, Mohs, excisions, biologics, and telederm?
Who handles prior authorizations, biologics, pathology tracking, and callbacks?
Is there control over template length and cosmetic scheduling?
APP supervision: How many APPs would I supervise?
Is APP supervision compensated by stipend, percentage of collections, RVU credit, chart fee, or not at all?
Who reviews charts, handles complications, biopsies, callbacks, and malpractice risk?
Are APP patients part of my panel, the group panel, or the APP's panel?
Quality bonus: Are metrics tied to access, biopsy follow-up, patient satisfaction, documentation, medication safety, or referral retention?
What is max quality bonus and historical payout?
Partnership / ancillary: Is partnership available and what is the buy-in?
Is there real estate, pathology, cosmetic-device, retail, or management-company income?
Who owns cosmetic revenue and device fees?
What happens to collections/partnership if I leave?
Contract risk: What is the noncompete radius and does it include cosmetics/Mohs/telederm?
Are patients, referral sources, online reviews, and social media accounts restricted after departure?
Are there repayment obligations or revenue carve-outs?

Clinical Fit: Medical/cosmetic/procedural mix matches goals and support staffing is adequate.
Compensation Upside: Collections %, cosmetics, pathology, devices, APP revenue, and overhead are transparent.
Lifestyle Fit: Patients/day, documentation, callbacks, and cosmetic schedule are sustainable.
Risk Safety: Noncompete, patient restrictions, tail, collections exclusions, and repayment terms are acceptable.
Strategic Fit: Partnership, brand, cosmetic/device growth, and referral demand build future value.
Collaborative Fit: MAs, scribes, APPs, pathologists, Mohs, and management support physician efficiency.
